title: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker and the warrior-poet of the Sun Empire who leads a desperate band to Orazca to summon the elder dinosaurs.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin and a loyal lancer who holds the gate at the Winged Temple and is wounded.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire leader of the Legion of Dusk auxiliaries, released from imperial dungeons to fight, who helps hold the temple gate.

entities.name: Temilo
entities.description: A Sun Empire scout garrisoned in Orazca who leads the company to the Winged Temple.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An engineer and planeswalker, Huatli's lover, who appears in Huatli's memory asking why fight what cannot be defeated.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: The emperor of the Sun Empire who loses his Dawn Fleet and authorizes Huatli's gambit.

entities.name: Caparocti Sunborn
entities.description: A commander of aerosaur fliers who questions Huatli's gambit.

entities.name: Yolotzin
entities.description: A warrior-poet from centuries ago whose story Huatli tells Saheeli.

entities.name: Phyrexian Etali
entities.description: The elder dinosaur Etali, turned by Phyrexia into a storm of engines and lightning, who attacks the Winged Temple.

entities.name: Zetalpa
entities.description: The elder dinosaur of dawn who tackles Etali and brings the sun.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: The three-headed elder dinosaur who answers last, kills Etali and communicates gratitude to Huatli.

entities.name: Tetzimoc
entities.description: The elder dinosaur of death who leads armored quetzacama.

entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: An elder dinosaur who fights giant Phyrexians.

entities.name: Nezahal
entities.description: The elder dinosaur of the tides who crushes a Phyrexian giant.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the Sun Empire and the Legion of Dusk, now under Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The continent that the emperor's navy was intended to invade.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A golden city of Ixalan that burns during the Phyrexian assault.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The Sun Empire capital encircled by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: The imperial citadel in Pachatupa converted to a war room.

entities.name: Winged Temple of Orazca
entities.description: A temple in Orazca with three hundred steps leading to a recitation chamber.

entities.name: Fortress Leor
entities.description: A Legion fortress the Sun Empire captured, taking ships.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Phyrexian World Tree whose branch descended onto Ixalan.

entities.name: The Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan led by the emperor from Pachatupa.

entities.name: The Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire legion of Torrezon whose auxiliaries aid Huatli.

entities.name: Huatli's lancers
entities.description: Huatli's company of lancers.

entities.name: The elder dinosaurs
entities.description: Ixalan's elder dinosaurs, embodiments of the plane.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde invading Ixalan.

entities.name: The Threefold Sun
entities.description: The Sun Empire's triune sun god, which has set and not risen.

events.summary: Huatli waits atop the Winged Temple while Orazca burns and Ixalan is wreathed in fire.
events.quote: Huatli, alone, stood atop the Winged Temple of Orazca

events.summary: Hours before, Huatli's company and the auxiliaries shelter in a barricaded hall, and Inti urges them to go.
events.quote: I'm not confident the barricade or this hall will hold.

events.summary: Huatli tells Mavren the trap was part of her plan, since bait is necessary when hunting a great beast.
events.quote: Bait is necessary.

events.summary: The Sun Empire storms Fortress Leor, taking ships it will copy for an invasion of Torrezon.
events.quote: The empire moved in, taking Leor and splitting the Legion forces of Queen's Bay in half.

events.summary: A branch of Realmbreaker splits the sky over the Sun Coast and Phyrexians invade Ixalan.
events.quote: revealing a hideous, colossal metal branch of Realmbreaker, the Invasion Tree

events.summary: The Phyrexians end the emperor's war and the Threefold Sun does not rise again.
events.quote: The Phyrexians came to Ixalan and ended the emperor's war in its cradle.

events.summary: In the imperial war room, the emperor learns his fleet of ten thousand is lost and Caparocti warns of unnatural storms.
events.quote: Where is my navy,

events.summary: Commanders report the collapse of the empire's defenses as Phyrexians ring Pachatupa.
events.quote: This was not a war: it was a collapse, seeking its end point.

events.summary: Huatli proposes calling the elder dinosaurs to Orazca to draw the Phyrexians from Pachatupa.
events.quote: I will call the elder dinosaurs to Orazca,

events.summary: The emperor silences Caparocti's objections and approves Huatli's gambit.
events.quote: Your desire to protect the heart of our empire is admirable, but be silent.

events.summary: Huatli's company and released vampire auxiliaries leave Pachatupa along the river while the army stages a diversion.
events.quote: A diversion, a furious barrage and single attempt at breaking the Phyrexian encirclement.

events.summary: Mavren demands freedom as a reward, and Huatli says they never made a bargain.
events.quote: We never made a bargain,

events.summary: At Orazca, scouts report a route to the temple and Temilo, a garrisoned soldier, joins them.
events.quote: We have a route to the temple.

events.summary: Etali, an elder dinosaur turned by Phyrexia, appears on the horizon with a roar and a storm.
events.quote: On the horizon opposite them, at the lip of the bowl in which Orazca was built, stood Etali, one of the elder dinosaurs.

events.summary: Huatli sees that nothing of Ixalan is left in Etali and flees with the company to Temilo's garrison.
events.quote: Etali was the storm. The Phyrexians had turned the elder dinosaur

events.summary: Huatli rejects the idea of being mere survivors and resolves to fight to the top of the Winged Temple to call the elders.
events.quote: Then we will fight to the top and call upon the elders.

events.summary: Inti, Mavren and the company hold the temple gate as Huatli climbs three hundred steps to the recitation chamber.
events.quote: We'll hold the gate,

events.summary: A flood of Phyrexians climbs the temple's steps toward the line.
events.quote: In ones and twos, they started up the lowest steps of the temple

events.summary: In a memory, Huatli tells Saheeli the story of the warrior-poet Yolotzin and tells her it will be alright.
events.quote: What we face is no different than what she faced

events.summary: Huatli recites to the hurricane and the powers of Ixalan, asking them to stand against the end.
events.quote: Huatli spoke to the hurricane.

events.summary: Etali's storm falters and the company's line holds against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: The storm faltered.

events.summary: Zetalpa, elder of dawn, pierces Etali's hurricane and slams into him, banishing the night.
events.quote: the titanic silhouette of Zetalpa, the elder of dawn, pierced Etali's hurricane

events.summary: Tetzimoc, Ghalta and Nezahal answer Huatli's call and tear through the Phyrexians in the streets.
events.quote: Nezahal wrapped the giant up from legs to wrists

events.summary: Huatli finds Inti wounded and Mavren having carried him from the line.
events.quote: A blood-slick and oil-stained Mavren limped toward Huatli, dragging a wounded Inti with him.

events.summary: Zacama, the last and greatest elder, arrives and her roar disintegrates the Phyrexian front ranks.
events.quote: Zacama, the final and greatest of the elders, loomed up from the shadows

events.summary: Zacama kills the turned Etali by tearing off his head.
events.quote: Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.

events.summary: Zacama acknowledges Huatli before departing, and the sun breaks through over Orazca.
events.quote: Dawn had arrived: the day, though not yet won, was here.

relations.quote: She wanted to walk alongside this river with her love.
the thin, patrician leader of the auxiliaries
Do you have words for the dead, warrior-poet?

relations.note: commander of the emperor's aerosaur fliers
relations.quote: My aerosaur fliers stand ready to scour the oceans
Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.

relations.note: ended the emperor's war and ring the capital
relations.quote: A ring of white stones surrounded Pachatupa
wrapping him up in her wings, her mighty jaws closed around Etali's neck

relations.note: earlier warrior-poet whose example Huatli follows
relations.quote: There was a warrior-poet before me,
